etymology.historical_story: One possible cultural reference is Broom-Hilda, the comic strip created by Russell Myers in 1970. Its central character is a witch navigating comic predicaments. The distributor confirms the title and creator, but that history does not identify every occurrence of the lowercase string broomhilda. Its source context remains necessary.
